cases.name: Sherry Cole
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Sherry attended Chuckey Doak High School. She was a loving wife, mother, daughter, mamaw and sister."
cases.narrative: She was beaten in the head with a hammer and had puncture wounds on her neck.
